classes.title: sama vinyasa
classes.description: Our traditional flow with focus and fun. Sun salutations, a little heat, a lot of heart. Tap back into a sense of play with our signature flow.

classes.title: sama open
classes.description: A mindful pace to open and stretch. Movement, breathwork, meditation with expert adaptations offered for a myriad of levels.

classes.title: sama sculpt
classes.description: Refine and define. Our signature Sama flow with ergonomic light weights to build strength, improve endurance, and tone the entire body. Move, stretch, and sculpt your way to your strongest self - in mind and in body.

classes.title: sama yin flow
classes.description: Slow and steady. Breath work, supported poses and sometimes longer holds to restore and stimulate the relaxation response. Much of Yin is done seated or prone.

classes.title: sama core
classes.description: Strengthen from within. Mindful, Sama open level with a sprinkling of fun, focused core work to build stability, improve posture, enhance balance and support resilience.

classes.title: sama stretch
classes.description: Lengthen and release. Gentle, intentional movement—enhanced by straps and supportive props—encourages a deeper stretch and fascial release to improve mobility, ease tension, and create greater lightness and freedom in the body and mind.
classes.imageStyle: object-position: 22% 88%; transform: scale(1.5); transform-origin: left bottom

classes.title: sama strength
classes.description: Build and empower. Using resistance bands, light weights, and functional conditioning, we’ll fire up the body, build muscle, support bone health, and strengthen confidence in how you move and live—then cool down with intentional mobility and release.

classes.title: sama restore
classes.description: Rest and renew. Supported poses, breathwork, and stillness to deeply calm the nervous system, replenish energy, and invite lasting restoration.
